title: License an animal display establishment
what: Use premises as an animal display establishment of a prescribed class (such as a zoo or wildlife park) only under a licence.

sources.title: Exhibited Animals Protection Act 1986 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Each occupier of premises used as an animal display establishment of a prescribed class is guilty of an offence and liable to a penalty not exceeding 20 penalty units or to imprisonment for not more than 6 months, or to both, if the use of the premises as an animal display establishment of that class is not authorised by a licence
